messages:
alex: FYI our onboarding sample started failing in edge envs after the exports map change this morning. app boots fine locally but worker runtime chokes. stack trace below, any ideas?

maria: @alex can you paste the package.json exports block and the exact error? which SDK version are you running? :eyes: 

alex: sdk is our internal redwood-js-sdk v1.4.0. here's the exports section from package.json and the runtime error we see on Cloudflare workers: 

```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./server": "./dist/server.cjs"
}
```

Error (worker):

```
TypeError [ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION]: Cannot use import statement outside a module
    at new NodeError (internal/errors.js:...)
    at Loader.defaultLoad (internal/modules/esm/loader.js:...)
    at async Loader.getModuleJob (internal/modules/esm/loader.js:...)
```
